q: Do I need a Certificate of Compliance (COC) to sell my house?
a: Yes. In South Africa an Electrical Certificate of Compliance is needed when a property is sold. We inspect the installation and issue the certificate if it passes.

q: What happens if my installation fails the COC inspection?
a: We give you a clear list of the faults and a quote to fix them. Once the work is done we re-inspect and issue the certificate.

q: Why does my breaker keep tripping?
a: Common causes are an overloaded circuit, a faulty appliance, or damaged wiring. Do not keep resetting it. Book a fault-finding visit so we can test the circuit safely.

q: Do you work on weekends or after hours?
a: We work Monday to Friday and on Saturday mornings. Emergency call-outs are available on request and additional rates apply.

q: Can you prepare my home for solar panels?
a: Yes. We do the electrical groundwork and DB board changes so a solar installer can connect panels and an inverter safely.
